summary: M21 Phase 1 implements second-wave docs-site enhancement: capability routing, deeper architecture/principles docs, learning paths, status matrix, and reusable diagram/example conventions.
approach: Use the existing docs-site static content system. Add a new guides category for capability routing/status/learning patterns, expand architecture and API content where needed, and validate with docs lint/build. Keep all implementation changes scoped to docs-site navigation/content/rendering files.

data_flow.diagram: Brainstorm specs -> docs-site inventory/content files -> docs lint/build -> browser verification

design_decisions: Add a guides category instead of overloading architecture with all conceptual pages.
Keep Mermaid as copyable code blocks; do not add renderer dependency in this phase.
Use current source-of-truth files for capability status and API claims.

patterns: docs-site/src/client/data/content-*.ts exports Record<string, string> with HTML template strings
docs-site/src/client/data/inventory.ts owns categories and docPages navigation
docs-site/scripts/docs-lint.mjs validates content entries and endpoint hints
conventions: Chinese documentation copy with English technical terms preserved
Each doc content entry should include h2 headings
Endpoint snippets use pre/code blocks and are enhanced by DocPage
dependencies: LandingPage featured links depend on docPages ids
Build command runs docs:lint, tsc, and vite build
